name: GraviTech
description:
About This Game

From a Different Angle

In this 3D puzzle game, you will find yourself in a space laboratory dedicated to studying gravity. You will face numerous challenges that require you to see the world from a different angle—because here, gravity can be directed in any direction.

What You'll Find in This Game:

  • A variety of exciting levels

  • Over 10 unique interactive objects

  • A chance to test your sense of balance

  • Platforming sections

Level Editor

If the levels created by the developers aren't enough for you, you can create your own! The game features a flexible level editor to bring your ideas to life.

Signal System

The level editor includes its own visual programming language to expand your creative possibilities. It allows you to transform simple signals (such as pressing a button) into more complex computations.
short_desc: In this 3D puzzle you will need to turn your perception of the world. After all, the actions of the game take place in the laboratory on the study of gravity changes. Forget about the attraction to the ground.
